about: Test vectors for the Quran dataset's text_search folding. scripts/db/load-quran.py (search_fold) and lib/shared/utils/search_text.dart (SearchText.fold) must both produce `folded` from `input`. docs/product/quran-dataset-contract.md.

vectors.note: Al-Fatihah 1:1 in Uthmani script: wasla alef, superscript alef and tashkeel fold away
Uthmani small marks (U+06E1) are Quranic annotation marks
hamza-bearing alefs fold to bare alef
alef maqsura and farsi yeh fold to yaa
seated hamzas fold to a plain hamza
Arabic-Indic and extended digits fold to ASCII
Latin case folds; whitespace runs collapse and trim
